svg.title: Ketover Platonic doubling: two sheets and face-center necks
svg.desc: Original sweepout models for all five Platonic solids. A full genus-five cubical model and a cutaway show two spherical sheets joined by six radial necks. The five models have 4, 6, 8, 12 and 20 necks and genera 3, 5, 7, 11 and 19. These compact comparison surfaces are not computed shrinkers; compactness of the limiting shrinkers is not proved.

g.text: Two spherical sheets, joined at the face centers
Ketover’s Platonic doubling construction · original sweepout models
Inner sheet and connecting neck walls
SCHEMATIC · no numerical solution of the shrinker equation
The compact sweepout does not settle compactness or the ends of the min-max shrinker.
